selection: All five listed cohorts, all baseline failures with native oracle_success=true; retain each once. Post-hoc diagnostic, not a new evaluation sample.
control: Reuse recorded primitive poses, original dataset goal and scene navmesh. Reconstruct every selected route's pre/post distances before examining interior poses. No sensor render, policy call or simulator step.
limits: Goal and navmesh are privileged analysis inputs. Interior arrival is a symptom, not a deployable interrupt or a success outcome without STOP. No action abstraction learning or novel method claim.
